insurer: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited
sumInsured: Not specified (depends on Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table)

great.name: NCB
great.quote: The accumulated No Claim Bonus shall not exceed 50% of the Sum Insured ... In the event of a claim impacting the eligibility of a No Claim Bonus, the accumulated No Claim Bonus shall be reduced by 10% of the Sum Insured at the commencement of subsequent Policy Year.
great.explanation: No Claim Bonus can build up to 50% of Sum Insured and reduces by 10% of Sum Insured after a claim instead of resetting to zero. This helps you retain part of the bonus even after using the policy.

good.name: Restore Benefit
good.quote: Once in the Policy Year, We shall provide for a reload of the Sum Insured ... in case the available Sum Insured which shall be considered to be inclusive of accumulated No Claim Bonus (if any), is insufficient for covering a claim under the Policy as a result of previous claims in that Policy Year.
good.reference: Section C.I (h) Reload of Sum Insured
good.explanation: Once in a policy year, Sum Insured is reloaded if the available Sum Insured (including any NCB) is insufficient due to earlier claims in the same year. This gives you extra cover for multiple hospitalizations in one year.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the ﬁrst policy with Insurer.
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases and their direct complications are covered only after 24 months of continuous coverage. This means PED claims are not payable in the first 2 years.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the ﬁrst policy with us.
good.reference: Section D.I.2 Specified disease / procedure waiting period (Code-Excl02)
good.explanation: Listed diseases/procedures are covered only after 24 months of continuous coverage. This delays claims for those specified conditions for the first 2 years.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the ﬁrst policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Illnesses are not covered for the first 30 days from policy start, while accidents are covered immediately. This means early claims for sickness in the first month will be rejected.

good.name: Restore Benefit
good.quote: The reload of Sum Insured shall be available only for subsequent claims and not in relation to any Illness/ Injury (including its complications) for which a claim has been admitted for the Insured Person during that Policy Year.
good.reference: Section C.I (h) Reload of Sum Insured - Condition (iii)
good.explanation: Reloaded Sum Insured can be used only for subsequent claims and not for the same illness/injury (including complications) already claimed in that policy year. This limits the reload to different conditions within the year.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.quote: We shall cover the Medical Expenses incurred for the Insured Person’s Domiciliary Hospitalization, up to the limits as speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy
good.explanation: Domiciliary hospitalization expenses are covered up to limits shown in the Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table. This can help if treatment is taken at home when hospitalization is otherwise required.

good.name: Air Ambulance
good.quote: Domestic Emergency Assistance Services (including Air Ambulance)
good.explanation: Domestic emergency assistance includes air ambulance services, subject to the policy’s assistance terms. This can support emergency evacuation within India.

good.name: Air Ambulance
good.quote: International Emergency Assistance Services (including Air Ambulance)
good.explanation: International emergency assistance includes air ambulance services, subject to the policy’s assistance terms. This can support emergency evacuation during overseas travel (as per the policy conditions).

bad.name: Room Rent
bad.quote: Reasonable and Customary Charges for Room Rent ... up to the limits as speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy;
bad.reference: Section C.I (a) In-patient Hospitalization - What is covered (1)
bad.explanation: Room rent is payable only up to the limit mentioned in the Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table. If you choose a higher room category, your claim can be reduced and your out-of-pocket cost can rise.

bad.name: Proportionate Deduction
bad.quote: If the Insured Person is admitted in a room category/limit that is higher than the one that is speciﬁed ... then the Insured Person shall bear a rateable proportion of the total Associated Medical Expenses
bad.explanation: If you take a room higher than your eligible category/limit, you must bear a rateable proportion of associated medical expenses. This can sharply reduce the insurer payout beyond just the room rent difference.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Activ Care Policy Wordings - Annexure - I - List of Non-medical expenses ... 56 GLOVES ... 60 MASK ... 62 OXYGEN MASK ... 58 ANY KIT WITH NO DETAILS MENTIONED
bad.reference: Annexure I – List of Non-medical expenses
bad.explanation: Items listed as non-medical expenses (like gloves, masks and oxygen masks) are not covered. This increases out-of-pocket costs during hospitalization.

bad.name: Disease Sub-limits
bad.quote: Sublimit for listed illnesses: We will cover the Medical Expenses arising out of an Insured Person’s in-patient Hospitalization for the listed Illness/ conditions and limit as speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table.
bad.reference: Section C.I (j) Sublimit for listed illnesses
bad.explanation: In-patient hospitalization for listed illnesses/conditions is covered only up to sub-limits mentioned in the Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table. This can leave you underinsured for those specific conditions even if your Sum Insured is higher.

bad.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
bad.quote: We shall not be liable to pay for any claim made under this Beneﬁt in connection with: (1) Asthma... (5) Diabetes mellitus and insipidus; ... (7) Hypertension; ...
bad.reference: Section C.I (e) Domiciliary Hospitalization - What is not covered
bad.explanation: Domiciliary hospitalization claims are not payable for several common conditions such as asthma, diabetes and hypertension. This significantly reduces the usefulness of home-treatment cover for chronic illnesses.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: if the Age ... is 61 years or above... shall bear a Co-payment per claim ... as speciﬁed in Product Beneﬁt Table/Policy Schedule.
bad.explanation: If the insured person is age 61 years or above, a co-pay per claim applies as per the Product Benefit Table/Policy Schedule. This means seniors will have a mandatory share of every claim to pay themselves.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: If this option is chosen ... discount of 10% on the premium... If the Insured Person takes Inpatient hospitalization ... in a Hospital other than those listed as “Preferred Provider Network”, then the Policyholder / Insured Person shall bear a Co-Payment of 15% on each and every claim
bad.explanation: A 15% co-pay applies on each and every claim if you opt the PPN discount and take inpatient treatment outside the Preferred Provider Network. This means you will pay part of every such claim from your pocket even if the expense is otherwise covered.

unclear.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
unclear.quote: We shall cover ... the Insured Person’s Pre-hospitalization Medical Expenses incurred ... in accordance with the limits speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy
unclear.explanation: Pre-hospitalization expenses are covered, but the number of days/limit is only as per the Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table. You need to check your schedule to know whether it is 30/60/90 days and the applicable cap, if any.

unclear.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
unclear.quote: We shall cover ... the Insured Person’s Post-hospitalization Medical Expenses ... in accordance with the limits speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy
unclear.explanation: Post-hospitalization expenses are covered, but the number of days/limit is only as per the Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table. You need to check your schedule to know whether it is 60/90/180 days and the applicable cap, if any.

unclear.name: Cashless Network
unclear.quote: Cashless Facilities can be availed only at Our Network Providers/ Empanelled Service Providers. The complete list of Network Providers and Empaneled Service Providers is available on Our website
unclear.explanation: Cashless treatment is available only at the insurer’s network/empanelled providers, with the list hosted on the insurer website. Since the number of hospitals is not stated here, you should verify whether your preferred hospitals are in-network before buying.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
